poses.director_table_distance_metric: 8-neighbour grid distance >3 px; exactly reproduces supplied worst-pose table
poses.hole_policy: report-only: legacy holes and feedback9 seam measurements; detached components remain blocking

bleed_base_validation.basis: Cached pre-bleed seed agrees with every derive-time support pixel count and preserves exact original RGBA at every cached seed pixel

seams.acceptance: report-only: interior tears, natural negative space and underlay protrusion; director judges native MP4
seams.blocking_checks: native coverage, dimensions, reference transform and source-mask agreement
seams.reference_frame: approved rest silhouette projected through common body bone, including alpha; square 1px erosion before projection
seams.protrusion_metric: max Euclidean texel-centre distance of underlay outside posed material union to that union
seams.natural_negative_space: enclosed background outside projected uneroded rest silhouette; report only

feedback9.method: Capped, connected per-joint seams; seam metrics report-only; all pre-existing paint retained

exposed_hidden.blocking_scope: Exposed derived source texels only; approved visible and hidden-request paint report-only
exposed_hidden.provenance_policy: Exact original hidden-request mask/RGBA or visible source RGBA; seams, dilation, bleed and edited texels are derived

feedback11.supersedes: Cumulative margin-search support and historical bleed envelope

feedback12.blocking_scope: Exposed derived source texels only; approved visible and hidden-request paint report-only
